title: My Best Basic Tips for Using AI Tools as First Game Developer (I Started at 2022)
author: Novel-Common9013
selftext:
Hey everyone, as I said in other post, I am the [First Game](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451190/Kebabstar/) to make game with AI tools.

0. First, make plan using **/plan** as working.  
1. After plan, use **/grill-me** skills to iterate the created plan  
2. Create .md files and register your plan on .md file you will iterate.  
3. You have to iterate your coding & artwork until you get the similar result with your play.

Additional tips:  
Learn AI Agent Orchestration which is useful

Never use one agent on complex tasks, divide it.  


Now about Fundamentals:

Note: **DO NOT LISTEN** **developers** or **gamers** who tell you to **do it with just one prompt**.

comments.author: MrVulpe
comments.body: How do you learn agent orchestration?

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body:
Well, it is a design system of multiple agents in your system or game.   
  
For example, in game development:

* **UI Agent** → Designs menus, HUDs, and user flows.
* **Gameplay Agent** → Implements mechanics and gameplay code.
* **Art Agent** → Creates or integrates assets.
* **Testing Agent** → Runs automated tests and reports bugs.
* **Build Agent** → Compiles the project and packages releases.

This is a new term, and you can watch this video to understanding the basics

[https://youtu.be/EtSO9vU84ws](https://youtu.be/EtSO9vU84ws)
